description: Defines data structures related to PDCCH (Physical Downlink Control Channel) information, including power, allocation, and configuration details for 5G NR scheduling.

classes.name: pdcch_precoding_info
classes.description: Empty struct representing precoding information for PDCCH PDUs.

classes.name: tx_power_pdcch_information
classes.description: Contains power control offset for PDCCH transmission power.

classes.name: dci_context_information
classes.description: Holds context information for PDCCH DCI allocation, including configuration pointers, RNTI, scrambling parameters, CCE position, search space, and decision context.

classes.name: pdcch_dl_information
classes.description: Represents a downlink PDCCH allocation with associated context and DCI content.

classes.name: pdcch_ul_information
classes.description: Represents an uplink PDCCH allocation with associated context and DCI content.
